evidence.text: A tally 丨 of people 人
Pictograph of one stalk of bamboo. Same as one half of the character for bamboo (竹).
Variant of 箇 (“bamboo stalk”). Half of 竹 (“bamboo”). A variant is 亇.

[{"gloss": "tally, piece, item", "gsr": "0349a", "middle_chinese": "kaH", "old_chinese": "*kˤa[r]-s"}, {"fanqie": "古賀", "middle_chinese_guangyun": "見開一歌去", "source": "guangyun"}, {"old_chinese_zhengzhang": "kaːls", "rhyme_group": "歌", "source": "zhengzhang"}]
Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 固 represents the sound.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *kaːls): semantic 亻 (“person”) + phonetic 固 (OC *kaːs).
The semantics may have developed along the grammaticalisation process "bamboo stalk" (箇) > "piece, item" > "classifier for every category of noun" > "possessive particle, generic particle". If so, it would then possibly be cognate with 竿 (OC *kaːn, “bamboo, rod”). Compare Tibetan མཁར་བ (mkhar ba), འཁར་བ ('khar ba, “walking stick, staff”) and Thai ก้าน (gâan, “stem, stalk”).
